claims.claim_ar: تكرار فعل النداء «قُلْ» كوسيلة بلاغية لتقوية الصيغة الخبرية والتوكيد/التحكم في إرشاد السامع.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the imperative particle «قُلْ» as a rhetorical device to strengthen the informative formula and to control/emphasize the addressee's attention.
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided source chunks contain instances of «قُلْ» in related exegetical contexts (e.g. commands beginning with قُلْ), but they discuss other verses; confirm relevance to S6:A50 and whether the commentary explicitly treats the repetition as a rhetorical device in this specific ayah.
claims.rhetorical_effect: draws attention, gives authoritative voice to speaker, frames multiple statements as direct corrective instruction

claims.claim_ar: تكرار النفي بـ«لَا/وَلَا» في سياق الإنكار يخلق توكيداً لنفي المزاعم (نفي صفة الملكية أو العلم بالغيب)، فيكشف عن موقف حاسم واضح.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of negation «لَا / وَلَا» within denials creates emphasis for the negated claims (denying angelic status, knowledge of the unseen), revealing a decisive and clear stance.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited Kashshaf passage explicitly discusses a formula of negation in similar prophetic speech («قُلْ لا أَتَّبِعُ أَهْواءَكُمْ»), but it treats a different verse; mapping that observation to the triple negation pattern in S6:A50 should be validated against commentaries that treat this exact ayah.
claims.rhetorical_effect: strengthens denial, distances speaker from false attributions, leaves no ambiguity about what is being denied

claims.claim_ar: تحول الأسلوب من النفي والإيضاح إلى توجيه سؤال تأملي («هَلْ يَسْتَوِي...») يندرج تحت الالتفات البلاغي، أي تغيير نبرة الخطاب لإثارة تفكير السامع.
claims.claim_en: A shift in discourse from denial/exposition to a directed contemplative question («هل يستوي...») is an instance of iltifat (sudden change of address/tone), used to provoke the listeners' reflection.
claims.needs_review_reason: The Kashshaf chunk contains the pattern «قُلْ إِنِّي ...» showing different uses of «قُلْ» leading into explanatory material, but the specific treatment of the shift to the rhetorical question in S6:A50 is not explicitly present in the provided chunks and should be corroborated with tafsir passages that analyze the iltifat in this verse.
claims.rhetorical_effect: moves the audience from rejection of claims to active reflection; turns didactic denial into a moral-epistemic challenge
